MERGE INTO silver_lh.dbo.customers AS t USING bronze_lh.dbo.customers AS s
    ON t.CustomerID = s.CustomerID
    WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET t.CustomerName = s.CustomerName, t.Region = s.Region, t.SignupDate = s.SignupDate
    WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (CustomerID, CustomerName, Region, SignupDate) VALUES (s.CustomerID, s.CustomerName, s.Region, s.SignupDate)

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_lh.dbo.customer_totals USING DELTA AS
    SELECT o.CustomerID AS customer_id, CAST(SUM(o.order_amount) AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS total_amount, COUNT(*) AS order_count
    FROM bronze_lh.dbo.orders o GROUP BY o.CustomerID

INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE silver_lh.dbo.customer_totals
    SELECT o.CustomerID, CAST(SUM(o.order_amount) AS DECIMAL(18,2)), COUNT(*) FROM bronze_lh.dbo.orders o
    WHERE o.order_amount > 100 GROUP BY o.CustomerID
